title: upfly check --json: the result
description: The last line upfly check --json prints when the check runs. It fails, with exit code 1, when it finds something of a kind failOn names: by default a reference to an image that does not exist, and an image a reference uses that is larger than check.maxImageBytes when that is set; check.failOn in the config and --fail-on choose the kinds, and --warn makes nothing fail. An unused image never fails it. Progress and diagnostic lines come before it (events.json); a check that cannot run prints an error line instead (events.json).

exitCode.description: 0 when it passed, or under --warn; 1 when something of a kind failOn names was found.

passed.description: true exactly when exitCode is 0: nothing of a kind failOn names was found.

failOn.description: The kinds that fail the check in this run, from --warn (none), --fail-on, check.failOn in the config, or by default broken, and too-large when check.maxImageBytes is set.

findings.description: References to images that do not exist, and images in use larger than check.maxImageBytes. Each fails the check when failOn names its kind.

possiblyBroken.description: Image paths in code or data that name no file, listed apart from the findings: strings that start with / as a path on the site does, which Upfly does not read as references, so it cannot tell whether a page shows each. They fail the check only when failOn names possibly-broken.

paths.description: Each one, by file, then line.

leftOut.description: Paths --changed left out, since the change did not touch their files. A path naming an image the change deleted is kept wherever it is.

unlisted.description: Strings that end in an image extension and name no file but do not start with /, such as a file name a component joins to a folder: counted, not listed. upfly audit --include-discarded lists them.

maxImageBytes.description: The limit check.maxImageBytes set in the config file, or null when none is set.

changed.description: With --changed: the git ref the change was measured from (null for the uncommitted changes) and how many files it touched. null without --changed.

leftOut.description: Findings --changed left out, since the change did not touch their files. A reference to an image the change deleted is kept wherever it is.

unusedOverLimit.description: Images over the limit that no reference uses. They never fail the check.

unchecked.description: References that could not be checked, since Upfly cannot know which file each names, such as a path built at runtime. upfly audit lists them.

unread.description: Files that could not be parsed or read, so no reference in them was checked. Absent when there are none; upfly audit names them.

fewResolved.description: Present when the folders the site is served from were named, with --public or publicDirs, and under a quarter of the root-relative references resolved in them. If the site is served from there, the rest name no file there: each is among the findings. Without a named folder the check stops instead, with an error line (events.json).

folders.description: The folders named, relative to the project, . being the project itself.

checkable.description: Root-relative references that could be checked: those that resolved and those that name no file.

checkKind.description: What can fail the check: broken, a reference to an image that does not exist; too-large, an image in use larger than check.maxImageBytes; possibly-broken, an image path in code or data that names no file.

possiblyBrokenPath.description: A string in code or data that looks like a path on the site and names no file.

file.description: The source file, relative to the project.

line.description: The line, from 1, or null when the file could not be read again.

where.description: file:line, or the file alone when the line is unknown.

note.description: The image it names in another letter case, which loads on Windows and macOS and not on a Linux server. Absent when there is nothing more to say.

tooLargeFinding.description: An image a reference uses whose file is larger than check.maxImageBytes.
